events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis and Beady Eye frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam's Birthday
angles.copy: Our Kid is another year older! Happy 54th to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis or solo track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' single released (1975)
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic single 'Imagine' was re-released in the UK on this day in 1975 to promote the compilation album 'Shaved Fish'.

angles.name: Imagine 1975
angles.copy: 51 years since 'Imagine' was re-released as a single in the UK. A powerful message that still resonates today.

events.title: Apple unveiled the first iPod (2001)
events.blurb: Apple introduced the original iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising portable music with '1,000 songs in your pocket'.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember the first time you scrolled through your music on an iPod? It's 25 years since Apple unveiled the device that changed how we listen.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global celebrations mark James Bond Day, commemorating the premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Bond Day
angles.copy: Grab your martini, shaken not stirred! It's James Bond Day, celebrating 007's cinematic legacy. Which Bond theme is your all-time favourite?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles co-founder, singer, and songwriter John Lennon was born on this day in 1940.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Cleese's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the comedy genius, John Cleese! What's your favourite Monty Python sketch or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released (1968)
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but commonly known as the 'White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years ago, The Beatles delivered their eclectic double LP, 'The White Album'. A sprawling masterpiece that proved their versatility.

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's death
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Queen's legendary frontman, Freddie Mercury, who died in 1991 at the age of 45 due to complications from AIDS.

angles.name: Freddie's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the incredible Freddie Mercury, 35 years on from his passing. His voice and showmanship remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released (1965)
events.blurb: The Beatles released their sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', on this day in 1965, marking a significant artistic progression for the band.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: 61 years since The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul', an album that pushed their sound and songwriting to new heights. Which track is your favourite?

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's death
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of music icon John Lennon in 1980.

angles.name: Lennon Remembrance
angles.copy: 46 years ago today, the world lost a visionary. Remembering John Lennon and his timeless message of peace and love.
